metadata.description: EigenLayer is a restaking protocol on Ethereum where users deposit liquid staking tokens (stETH, ETHx, mETH, and others) into strategy contracts, or point native validator withdrawal credentials at EigenPods, to extend those assets' cryptoeconomic security to Actively Validated Services (AVSs). The core contracts are upgradeable behind transparent proxies and governed by two timelocks: a 10-day timelock for Protocol Council upgrades, and a 24-day timelock that applies to EIGEN and bEIGEN token upgrades. A 1-of-7 Pauser Multisig can freeze all strategy contracts, locking $1.27B in restaked LSTs without on-chain time delay, while the Unpauser (1-of-2 Owning Multisig) can restore operations. Each supported LST token contract is a direct dependency: a malfunction or compromise of those contracts would affect the strategy holding that token.

admins.name: EigenLayer Pauser Multisig (1-of-7)
admins.description: Can call pause() and pauseAll() on all 13 strategy contracts (12 StrategyBaseTVLLimits + EigenStrategy), DelegationManager, StrategyManager, AllocationManager, RewardsCoordinator, AVSDirectory, and related contracts. When paused, user deposit and withdrawal operations on those contracts are blocked until the EigenLayerOwningMultisig (unpauser) restores them. Direct capital subject to pause: $1.27B.

mitigations.description: Sets the timestamp at which the Pectra hard fork's withdrawal proof format activates. A malicious value (far future) breaks beacon-chain withdrawal proof validation across all EigenPods; setting to past creates invalid-format reverts on legitimate withdrawal proofs. Callable only by proofTimestampSetter (single address).

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Sets the delay between a distribution root submission and its activation. Future-only — applies to subsequent submitted roots, not existing pending roots. Bounded by MAX_ACTIVATION_DELAY in the contract.

mitigations.label: future-fee-redirect
mitigations.description: Sets the protocol fee recipient address for rewards distribution. Future fees on distribution roots go to the new recipient; cannot extract historical fees already settled. Owner is EigenLayerOwningMultisig (1-of-2).

mitigations.label: role-transfer-rewards-control
mitigations.description: Sets the rewardsUpdater address — the single address allowed to submit and disable distribution roots. A malicious updater could submit a fraudulent root claiming all earners' rewards to attacker-controlled addresses, but each root has activationDelay before becoming claimable, giving a window for governance to disableRoot.

mitigations.label: role-grant
mitigations.description: Adds/removes an address from the rewardsForAllSubmitter whitelist. Those addresses can call createRewardsForAllSubmission, which depositors of incentives use to fund rewards from their own balance — no extraction surface.

admins.name: StrategyFactory
admins.description: Internal protocol contract that deploys and manages StrategyBaseTVLLimits proxies. The Operations Multisig owns it. Can whitelist or blacklist tokens from new strategy deployments and add/remove strategies from the deposit whitelist in StrategyManager. No direct fund exposure since it only affects deployment of new strategies, not existing ones.

admins.name: RewardsCoordinator Updater (EOA)
admins.description: Externally owned account set as rewardsUpdater on the RewardsCoordinator. Can submit distribution roots (submitRoot) and disable pending roots (disableRoot) for the EIGEN rewards distribution system. Root submissions activate after a 7-day delay during which they can be overridden. No direct fund exposure to restaked LSTs.

mitigations.label: activation-delay-bound
mitigations.description: Submitted root activates after 7-day delay (activationDelay). During this window, the root can be reviewed and a new correct root submitted, overriding the malicious one.

mitigations.label: root-veto
mitigations.description: Marks a distribution root as disabled before activation. onlyRewardsUpdater + onlyWhenNotPaused(PAUSED_SUBMIT_DISABLE_ROOTS). Vetoes a single root from being claimed (defensive); cannot extract funds. Same semantics as a cancel-payload.

admins.name: EIGEN Incentive Council (3-of-5 Multisig)
admins.description: The incentiveCouncil of the EmissionsController, responsible for adding and updating EIGEN emission distributions across AVSs and strategies. Controls how weekly EIGEN token emissions are allocated. Can also call sweep() on the EmissionsController to recover non-EIGEN tokens sent to the contract.

mitigations.label: future-emissions-only
mitigations.description: Adds a new emissions distribution starting from a future epoch. Bounded by per-epoch emission rates configured in the protocol; cannot directly extract existing funds. The council can direct future EIGEN emissions to chosen recipients (operators/AVSs).

mitigations.label: future-emissions-only
mitigations.description: Replaces an existing distribution's parameters. Affects future epochs only; cannot rewrite past emissions. Same scope risk as addDistribution.

admins.name: EigenDA EjectionManager
admins.description: Internal EigenDA contract that can eject operators from quorums via the RegistryCoordinator's ejectOperator() function. Controlled by the EigenDA Operations Multisig. Ejection affects operator participation in EigenDA quorums but does not touch restaking balances or user withdrawal rights.

admins.name: EigenDA Operations Multisig (3-of-4)
admins.description: Owner of EigenDAServiceManager, RegistryCoordinator, and related EigenDA contracts. Can set quorum operator set parameters, churn approver, ejector, staleStakesForbidden flag, batch confirmers, and rewards initiator. Also owns the EigenDA ProxyAdmin (0x8247EF) controlling upgrades to EigenDA contracts. No direct exposure to restaked LST balances.

mitigations.label: role-management
mitigations.description: Sets the address that approves operator churn (replacing operators when quorum is full). Operational role; no direct fund movement. A malicious approver could enable bad operators to replace honest ones, but this affects AVS correctness, not protocol funds.

mitigations.label: role-management
mitigations.description: Sets the ejector role on the registry coordinator. Same scope as EjectionManager.setEjector — operational role for AVS membership management, no fund movement.

mitigations.label: role-management
mitigations.description: Sets the address allowed to initiate rewards distribution events for this AVS. Doesn't move funds itself; the initiator can only submit reward distributions (depositing rewards from their own balance).

mitigations.label: rewards-redirect
mitigations.description: Calls RewardsCoordinator.setClaimerFor(claimer) for THIS AVS. The new claimer can then call RewardsCoordinator.processClaim to redirect this AVS's accrued rewards to themselves. Bounded by the rewards already accrued + future rewards until the claimer is changed back. Owner is EigenDAOperationsMultisig (3-of-4).

mitigations.label: role-management
mitigations.description: Sets the address allowed to call confirmBatch. The batch confirmer is an operational role for EigenDA data availability — no direct fund movement. A malicious confirmer could confirm bad batches (DA layer correctness impact, not protocol fund impact).

mitigations.label: future-only-validity-check
mitigations.description: Toggles whether stale-stake signatures are forbidden on batch confirmation. Operational data-availability correctness param; no fund movement.

mitigations.label: proxy-admin-upgrade
mitigations.description: Upgrade authority for 11 EigenDA proxies: BLSApkRegistry, EigenDADisperserRegistry, EigenDARelayRegistry, EigenDAServiceManager, EigenDAThresholdRegistry, etc. A malicious impl could break operator registration, ejection, or batch confirmation. Owner is EigenDAOperationsMultisig (3-of-4 GnosisSafe).

mitigations.label: proxy-admin-upgrade
mitigations.description: Upgrade authority for 11 EigenDA proxies: BLSApkRegistry, EigenDADisperserRegistry, EigenDARelayRegistry, EigenDAServiceManager, EigenDAThresholdRegistry, etc. A malicious impl could break operator registration, ejection, or batch confirmation. Owner is EigenDAOperationsMultisig (3-of-4 GnosisSafe).

mitigations.label: proxy-admin-upgrade
mitigations.description: Upgrade authority for 11 EigenDA proxies: BLSApkRegistry, EigenDADisperserRegistry, EigenDARelayRegistry, EigenDAServiceManager, EigenDAThresholdRegistry, etc. A malicious impl could break operator registration, ejection, or batch confirmation. Owner is EigenDAOperationsMultisig (3-of-4 GnosisSafe).

mitigations.label: role-management
mitigations.description: Sets/unsets an address in the ejector role. The ejector can eject operators from the AVS (kicking them out of the operator set) but cannot extract protocol funds — ejection is an AVS operational action, not a financial one. EigenLayer slashing is governed separately by AllocationManager.

mitigations.label: data-availability-config
mitigations.description: Registers a disperser address against a key in the EigenDA disperser registry. Operational coordination data; no read sites that affect fund movement. A bad disperser would impact DA-layer message routing but not protocol-tracked funds.

mitigations.label: data-availability-config
mitigations.description: Adds a relay to the EigenDA relay registry. Operational P2P data routing for EigenDA blob retrieval; no fund-movement read sites.

mitigations.label: data-availability-config
mitigations.description: Adds a versioned blob threshold parameter set. Used by EigenDA to validate blob attestations; no fund-movement read sites.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Sets a payment reservation for a future depositor account. Only affects future on-demand-payment accounting; no current fund movement. Quorum split is validated on-chain.

mitigations.label: bounded-by-vault-balance
mitigations.description: Withdraws native ETH from PaymentVault to owner(). Bounded by PaymentVault's own ETH balance (currently ~1.52 ETH). Owner is EigenDAOperationsMultisig (3-of-4 GnosisSafe), and the destination is hard-coded to owner() — cannot route to arbitrary address, only to the multisig itself.

mitigations.label: bounded-by-vault-balance
mitigations.description: Withdraws any ERC20 from PaymentVault to owner(). Bounded by the vault's balance of the requested token. Destination is hard-coded to owner() (EigenDAOperationsMultisig 3-of-4).

admins.name: EigenDA RegistryCoordinator
admins.description: Internal EigenDA contract that manages operator registration and deregistration in BLSApkRegistry, IndexRegistry, StakeRegistry, and SocketRegistry. Called by EigenDA operators to join/leave quorums. Not a human-controlled admin — it is gated by on-chain quorum rules and ejection logic.

admins.name: EigenDA Batch Confirmer (EOA)

mitigations.label: role-management
mitigations.description: Sets the isPauser mapping; the resulting pauser can pause/unpause protocol functions on EigenLayer contracts. The pause function itself is the critical surface — this setIsPauser is one step removed. A malicious unpauser could grant pauser to attacker who could then freeze deposits/withdrawals across the protocol via the various pausable contracts. No direct fund movement. Caller must hold the unpauser address (single-address role, not a multisig role).

mitigations.label: role-transfer

A malicious new unpauser could revoke all legitimate pausers (DoS on pause function) but cannot directly extract funds. Caller must hold the current unpauser address.

mitigations.label: activation-delay-bound
mitigations.description: Submitted root activates after 7-day delay (activationDelay). During this window, the root can be reviewed and a new correct root submitted, overriding the malicious one.

mitigations.label: root-veto
mitigations.description: Marks a distribution root as disabled before activation. onlyRewardsUpdater + onlyWhenNotPaused(PAUSED_SUBMIT_DISABLE_ROOTS). Vetoes a single root from being claimed (defensive); cannot extract funds. Same semantics as a cancel-payload.

mitigations.label: future-emissions-only
mitigations.description: Adds a new emissions distribution starting from a future epoch. Bounded by per-epoch emission rates configured in the protocol; cannot directly extract existing funds. The council can direct future EIGEN emissions to chosen recipients (operators/AVSs).

mitigations.label: future-emissions-only
mitigations.description: Replaces an existing distribution's parameters. Affects future epochs only; cannot rewrite past emissions. Same scope risk as addDistribution.

mitigations.label: role-management
mitigations.description: Sets the address that approves operator churn (replacing operators when quorum is full). Operational role; no direct fund movement. A malicious approver could enable bad operators to replace honest ones, but this affects AVS correctness, not protocol funds.

mitigations.label: role-management
mitigations.description: Sets the ejector role on the registry coordinator. Same scope as EjectionManager.setEjector — operational role for AVS membership management, no fund movement.

mitigations.label: role-management
mitigations.description: Sets the address allowed to initiate rewards distribution events for this AVS. Doesn't move funds itself; the initiator can only submit reward distributions (depositing rewards from their own balance).

mitigations.label: rewards-redirect
mitigations.description: Calls RewardsCoordinator.setClaimerFor(claimer) for THIS AVS. The new claimer can then call RewardsCoordinator.processClaim to redirect this AVS's accrued rewards to themselves. Bounded by the rewards already accrued + future rewards until the claimer is changed back. Owner is EigenDAOperationsMultisig (3-of-4).

mitigations.label: role-management
mitigations.description: Sets the address allowed to call confirmBatch. The batch confirmer is an operational role for EigenDA data availability — no direct fund movement. A malicious confirmer could confirm bad batches (DA layer correctness impact, not protocol fund impact).

mitigations.label: future-only-validity-check
